window.timeParsing: Date.parse(raw RFC3339 at string); a trailing Z remains UTC.

serverSideSameStreamNextOpenDelay.limitation: This only observes the next server-side open for the same stream label. There is no browser/tab/client identifier, so it is not a same-browser recovery duration and must not be attributed to a user, tab visibility, or network cause.

causeAssessment.pageHidden: No client.connection event in this window explicitly reported visible:false. Absence is not proof that no page was hidden.
causeAssessment.networkOffline: No client.connection event in this window explicitly reported online:false. ECONNRESET and ETIMEDOUT are transport/request failures, not a browser-offline diagnosis.
causeAssessment.processLifecycle: runtime.stop/start pairs are observed above; they establish process lifecycle timing only, not why the runtime stopped.
causeAssessment.userAction: No event carries a user-action or browser-tab identity. bridge client-close cannot be classified as a user action from these logs alone.
causeAssessment.providerHealth: provider.probe is excluded from causal attribution; it is not evidence that a connection failure was provider-caused.
causeAssessment.historical1334: The historical 13:34 trigger remains unknown. This audit does not retroactively classify it as hidden-page, network, process exit, or resolved.
causeAssessment.newFault: The window contains real closes, runtime restarts, and bridge transport failures. Without a prior comparable baseline or correlated browser identifiers, this audit cannot label them a new incident or a resolved historical fault.
